model.name: Task 30.49: Delete a dynamic repo from the manage panel (builtins never removable)
model.description: The manage panel lets a user DELETE a dynamic (user-added) repo — after delete it is gone from the selector + the dynamic registry (via RepoRegistry.unregister). BUILTIN repos (rawbin, oosh) are NEVER removable: the delete affordance is absent/disabled and unregister refuses them. V1 delete is read-auth only (no admin-key; D4 requireAdmin stays deferred to R30.48). The pending BUILD is the delete-UI wiring onto the already-proven unregister spine.
model.intention: S30 diff/merge editor — R30.49 delete-for-removable (Tron-approved, V1 push): the manage panel can remove a user-added repo, builtins protected.

The pending BUILD = wiring the delete-UI → unregister (blocked-on-build, expert builds WITH UC7 on architect's final-matrix green-light). D4 admin-auth deferred → R30.48/BH-3.
